verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical and share the same flaws. The headline is squeezed into three tight lines that fill the full banner height. The legal fine print sits in a narrow column on the far right, wraps into six lines and is almost as large as the offer copy, so it competes with the CTA. The tilted sale ribbon is wedged into the bottom-left corner, and the bottle is tiny. B keeps the SOLSTICE logo at a readable size above the ribbon. A shrinks the logo to an illegible speck, which hurts the brand, so B is slightly better.
